notes: Re-QA against current bytes after the fresh-spinach re-bid. Live page fetched successfully and matches the extraction exactly (4 servings, 9 ingredients, same method). Every extracted ingredient maps to a spec line and vice versa; all nine lines scale on one 3.5x ratio (4 -> 14): chicken 4->14 breasts (2800 g at house 200 g each), spices 1 tsp -> 3 1/2 tsp, butter 2 tbsp -> 7 tbsp, cream 1 cup -> 3 1/2 cups (833 g), sun-dried tomatoes 1/2 -> 1 3/4 cups (193 g on the oil-packed 110 g/cup row), garlic 2 -> 7 cloves, spinach 1 -> 3 1/2 cups (105 g fresh). Method preserved (season, sear in butter, cream/tomato/garlic sauce, wilt spinach, return chicken); title names the same dish; credit points at thatlowcarblife.com/creamy-tuscan-chicken. No built body.html exists at db\built\creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet.body.html at QA time, so this verdict covers the spec bytes only.
